steps.title: Trigger Timing

guide.title: Salary Calculation Guide
guide.brief: Monthly salary calculation integrating attendance, social insurance, tax, commission and adjustments. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.desc: Configure salary items, social insurance policies, tax rules, attendance records, and commission rules first.

steps.title: Trigger Calculation
steps.desc: Trigger the monthly calculation engine; system auto-aggregates base pay, performance, commission, and attendance deductions.

steps.title: Calculation Logic
steps.desc: Gross = base + performance + commission + overtime; Net = gross - social insurance - housing fund - tax - other deductions.

steps.title: Employee Confirmation
steps.desc: Payslips are generated after calculation; employees can view, confirm, or file appeals.

steps.title: Bank Disbursement
steps.desc: Export bank payment files and optionally push payslip notifications to employees.

guide.title: Expense Reimbursement Guide
guide.brief: Employees submit expenses, multi-level approval, then finance pays. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Submit Expense
steps.desc: Fill in expense type, amount, date, upload receipts; multiple line items supported.

steps.title: Approval Flow
steps.desc: Auto-matches approval flow by type and amount; supports multi-level and counter-signing.

steps.title: Finance Review
steps.desc: After approval, finance verifies receipt authenticity and amount accuracy; can reject for supplement.

steps.title: Payment Registration
steps.desc: Register payment info (bank reference, payment date) after review to complete reimbursement.

steps.title: Status Tracking
steps.desc: Status flow: draft → pending → approving → approved → paid / rejected.

guide.title: Tax Management Guide
guide.brief: Maintain progressive tax rates and employee deductions; auto-calculates cumulative withholding. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Tax Rate Config
steps.desc: Maintain seven-level progressive tax table, set threshold and quick deduction.

steps.title: Special Deductions
steps.desc: Configure employee special additional deductions: children's education, continuing education, medical, housing loan, rent, elderly care.

steps.title: Cumulative Withholding
steps.desc: Calculate annual cumulative tax, monthly progressive withholding, year-end reconciliation.

steps.title: Employee Config
steps.desc: Bind tax scheme to employees, set deduction details and exemption limits.

steps.title: Salary Linkage
steps.desc: Auto-calculates current period tax during salary calculation, generates tax detail report.

guide.title: Social Insurance & Housing Fund Guide
guide.brief: Configure base and rates by region; auto-deducted from salary after enrollment. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Policy Config
steps.desc: Set social insurance (pension/medical/unemployment/injury/maternity) and housing fund base ranges and rates by region.

steps.title: Employee Enrollment
steps.desc: Configure enrollment scheme: region, contribution base, start month.

steps.title: Effective Rules
steps.desc: Starts from the enrolled month; base adjusted annually (usually July), changes effective next month.

steps.title: Salary Linkage
steps.desc: Auto-calculates and deducts employee portions (pension/medical/unemployment/fund) during salary calculation.

steps.title: Employer Portion
steps.desc: Employer contributions are tracked separately, not deducted from net pay but counted as labor cost.

guide.title: Payslip Distribution Guide
guide.brief: Generate monthly payslips and distribute to employees via multiple channels with read tracking and withdrawal. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Generate Payslip
steps.desc: Select year and month to generate payslips; system pulls details from salary calculation results into employee-readable slips.

steps.title: Select Channel
steps.desc: Supports inbox, email, SMS, WeCom, DingTalk and Feishu channels; multi-select allowed.

steps.title: Single / Batch
steps.desc: Send a single payslip or select multiple for batch sending; status becomes Sent after delivery.

steps.title: Read Tracking
steps.desc: Status updates to Read after employee views; backend shows sent/read/unread statistics.

steps.title: Withdrawal
steps.desc: Sent but unread payslips can be withdrawn; they become invisible to employees after withdrawal.

guide.title: Bank Export Guide
guide.brief: Generate monthly bank payment files (TXT/Excel) per bank for salary disbursement. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.desc: Salary calculation must be completed and approved; employee bank account info must be maintained.

steps.title: Select Parameters
steps.desc: Choose year, month, bank type (ICBC/CCB/CMB/BOC/ABC) and file format (TXT or Excel).

steps.title: Generate File
steps.desc: System aggregates monthly net salary per bank specification and generates the file; status: Generating → Success/Failed.

steps.title: Preview & Download
steps.desc: TXT format allows content preview and download; Excel format downloads the binary file directly.

steps.title: Submit to Bank
steps.desc: Download and submit the payment file to the corresponding bank's online banking system to complete disbursement.

guide.title: Attendance Deduction Guide
guide.brief: Record monthly attendance data and calculate deductions/overtime pay, linked with salary calculation. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Data Entry
steps.desc: Enter work days, actual days, late/early-leave/absent counts, leave days and overtime hours per employee per month.

steps.title: Batch Import
steps.desc: Supports Excel batch import; template must include Employee ID, Year, Month, Work Days and other fields.

steps.title: Deduction Calculation
steps.desc: System calculates late/early-leave/absent/leave deductions plus overtime pay and full-attendance bonus to get net adjustment.

steps.title: Linked Calculation
steps.desc: Attendance deductions and overtime pay participate in monthly salary calculation, affecting gross and net pay.

steps.title: Query & Manage
steps.desc: Filter attendance records by year and month; supports editing corrections and recalculating deductions.

guide.title: Salary Adjustment Guide
guide.brief: Manage employee base salary, position allowance and performance base adjustments with approval flow and history. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Add Adjustment
steps.desc: Select employee, adjustment type (regularization/annual/promotion/transfer/special) and fill in old/new salary and reason.

steps.title: Submit Approval
steps.desc: After creation, the record enters pending approval; approver can approve or reject with a reject reason.

steps.title: Effective Linkage
steps.desc: Once approved, the new base/allowance/performance base syncs to salary calculation; next month uses the new standard.

steps.title: History Tracking
steps.desc: View an employee's full adjustment history including salary amounts, reasons and approval results.

steps.title: Status Flow
steps.desc: Status flow: Pending → Approved / Rejected; approved records cannot be re-approved.

guide.title: Salary Items Guide
guide.brief: Maintain salary detail items (additions/deductions) and calc modes; formula mode supports variable references. Expand for details.

steps.title: Item Type
steps.desc: Additions count toward gross salary (e.g. base, commission, performance); deductions reduce gross (e.g. social insurance, tax, attendance deduction).

steps.title: Calc Mode
steps.desc: Fixed: use default amount; Formula: auto-calc via variable expression; Manual: enter per record during calculation.

steps.title: Formula Variables
steps.desc: Formulas can reference defined item variables like {baseSalary}, {commission}; system parses and replaces them during calculation.

steps.title: Tax Settings
steps.desc: Items marked taxable participate in tax calculation; deductions can be set as pretax (e.g. social insurance/housing fund) or post-tax.

steps.title: Sort & Enable
steps.desc: Sort controls payslip display order; disabled items do not participate in calculation or display.

guide.title: Team Commission Guide
guide.brief: Auto-calculates manager commission sharing from subordinates based on org structure, summarized monthly. Expand for logic.

steps.title: Hierarchy
steps.desc: Auto-identifies superior-subordinate relationships from department org structure; no manual hierarchy maintenance.

steps.title: Sharing Rules
steps.desc: Managers share direct subordinates' commissions by configured ratio; supports multi-level cascading.

steps.title: Monthly Summary
steps.desc: Monthly aggregation of manager sharing totals, including direct and indirect subordinates.

steps.title: Data Source
steps.desc: Sharing is based on generated subordinate commission results, reflecting real-time team performance.

steps.title: Usage
steps.desc: Used for manager performance calculation and salary disbursement; details exportable.

guide.title: Refund Record Guide
guide.brief: Refunds based on payment records, reviewed then sent to payment channel. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Initiate Refund
steps.desc: Based on existing payment records; fill refund amount and reason.

steps.title: Review Process
steps.desc: Refund applications enter pending review; finance reviews reasonableness.

steps.title: Channel Interaction
steps.desc: After approval, system calls payment channel refund API (WeChat/Alipay original route).

steps.title: Status Sync
steps.desc: On success, original payment record is updated to refunded status for consistency.

steps.title: Financial Impact
steps.desc: Refund amount is counted in financial statistics, affecting revenue reports.

guide.title: Payment Record Guide
guide.brief: Records C-end user online payment transactions, linked with member fees and orders. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Source
steps.desc: Auto-generated after C-end user pays in mini-program; records order ID, amount, payment method.

steps.title: Payment Methods
steps.desc: Supports WeChat Pay, Alipay, bank card and other channels.

steps.title: Status Flow
steps.desc: Pending → Success / Failed / Refunded, driven by payment channel callbacks.

steps.title: Linkage
steps.desc: On success, auto-generates member fee record, linked to order and user.

steps.title: Refund Processing
steps.desc: Refunds are initiated from the refund record page; status syncs back on success.

guide.title: Member Fee Usage Guide
guide.brief: Member fee records C-end subscriptions, linked with payment records and member products. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Member Product Setup
steps.desc: Configure pricing, duration and purchase limits for monthly/quarterly/yearly plans in member products.

steps.title: C-end Order & Payment
steps.desc: User selects a plan in the mini-program; system creates a payment record and invokes WeChat Pay; callback updates status on success.

steps.title: Member Fee Generation
steps.desc: On successful payment, a member fee record is auto-generated with validity period, linked payment record ID and member type.

steps.title: Backend Management
steps.desc: This page is for backend adjustment or querying. Normally fees are auto-generated by the C-end payment flow; manual creation is rarely needed.

steps.title: Status Flow
steps.desc: Inactive → Active (paid) → Expired (end of validity). Refunds will sync the payment record to refunded status.
